units.source_text: 不动明王是佛教中菩萨名，为密宗所尊重。

en.t: Fudo Myo-o is the name of a bodhisattva in Buddhism and is revered in Esoteric Buddhism.

units.source_text: 陀罗尼咒是一种符咒的名称。

en.t: A dharani spell is the name for a kind of incantation or talismanic charm.

units.source_text: 做手印，即念咒时做手势。

en.t: To make a hand seal means to form hand gestures while reciting a spell.
